description: The National Bank of Romania's reference rate in force on a day: RON per `multiplier` units of the currency (1, or 100 for HUF, JPY, KRW and a few others), as the exact text BNR published, with published_on, the date of the fixing it is. A weekend, a holiday, or today before BNR publishes (about 13:00 Bucharest) takes the last banking day's fixing. Use it for any EUR/RON or other conversion stated on a date.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code: EUR, USD, GBP, CHF, ... (XAU gold, XDR SDR); case ignored.

date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD in Bucharest; default today.

name: rate

published_on.description: The date of the fixing this rate is

rate.description: BNR's exact text, RON per `multiplier` units

title: BNR rate on a day
